title: 3D scene

status.stopped: Simulation stopped: view only, controls have no effect

missingSession: Session not found. Open the scene from the editor.
unknownScene: Scene unknown to this version of Studomate.

cartonSorting.label: Carton sorting
cartonSorting.description: Input conveyor, three pushing cylinders and two outputs: low cartons go to P2's level, high cartons to P3's level.

crossroads.label: Crossroads
crossroads.description: Two crossing roads, four traffic lights and an automatic flow of cars that obey the lights. If both axes get through at the same time, the cars collide.

drilling.label: Drilling
drilling.description: Drilling station: a drill goes down and back up between two limit switches (top and bottom), and a spindle makes it turn. Drilling requires the spindle to turn with the drill at the bottom for 1.5 s.

elevator.label: Lift
elevator.description: Three-floor car: up, down and door commands, a presence sensor at each floor and a door-open sensor. The door stays open at least 2 s before it can close again.
